# content/ — sacred and reference content

**Do not edit any file in this folder by hand or with AI.** Files are imported verbatim from their sources.

| Folder | Source |
|---|---|
| quran/ | Tanzil.net — Uthmani text (keep the copyright header) |
| translations/ | QuranEnc.com — one file per translation, with version number |
| azkar/ | Hisn al-Muslim — verified edition, each item with its reference |
| hadith/ | HadeethEnc.com |
| stories/ | Scholar-reviewed scripts only |
| cards/ | Dhikr phrases, Arabic words, facts for kids game cards (reviewed) |

Each folder gets a `SOURCE.md` saying where the file came from, the date downloaded, and the version.
